_comment: 'Defense reactions can't be played to this chain link' is NOT implemented: defence reactions are played in the reaction step, which has no restriction hook, and the defend step already excludes them (CR 7.3.2a). It was authored as RESTRICT_DEFENSE_TO_HEAD_EQUIPMENT, which restricts ORDINARY defenders instead -- a real and wrong restriction in place of a missing one. Removed rather than approximated. Was DESTROY_TOKEN, which destroys ONE token of a named slug that the CONTROLLER controls. 'destroy a defense reaction card in their arsenal' -- an arsenal card matching a type, on the opponent's side.
